summary: Fifteen days to the Expo (Nov 4), with Smart Slots the company priority. Sam's final screens are delivered. Nina's ranking PR #232 awaits Arjun's review. Pinecrest wants a demo before signing. Harbor's CSV limit is fixed. The Harbor QBR is Thursday and Dana wants a written reliability plan.

items.text: Maya decided Smart Slots is the priority for everyone until Expo on Nov 4. Sync error work is deferred until after Expo unless sync worsens.
Maya decided the Expo booth gets a live demo, with a printed one-pager as backup.
Nina's ranking PR #232 (TW-116, due Oct 27) is ready but cannot merge until Arjun reviews it. Arjun's scoring API TW-115 (due Oct 28) needs that ranking.
Sam delivered the final slot picker screens in Figma, so Leila is no longer blocked. TW-117 is in progress and due Oct 29.
Sam is building the three-screen Expo demo (TW-119, due Oct 30). He needs realistic sample data for it.
Jordan will get an anonymized week of Coastal bookings from Grace today for the Expo demo. Coastal has agreed.
Coastal kickoff call is booked for Thursday. Valley is still waiting on data access. Design partner ticket TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Only two design partners are signed. Pinecrest, the needed third (TW-126, due Oct 30), wants to see a live demo before signing.
Arjun owns TW-127, API docs for Coastal and Valley, due Oct 26. They need the docs before going live.
Sync error rate was 1.6% on Oct 18, above the 1% target, mostly Ridgeline duplicates (TW-103, todo). Ridgeline renews Nov 20 and is health yellow.
The Sep 28 postmortem (TW-101) is done. The cause was a sync worker crash with no retry. Arjun started retry queue TW-104. Alert TW-105 is still todo.
Harbor QBR is Thursday Oct 22. Jordan's deck (TW-112) is in progress. Maya has spoken with Dana, and Dana called the renewal routine.
Dana asked for a written reliability plan before Thursday's QBR. Maya owns TW-131, due Oct 22.
Nina fixed Harbor's CSV export limit: exports over 5,000 rows now complete (TW-102 done).
Harbor ops reports Fresno DC appointments showing UTC times. Jordan logged TW-130 (API, Nina) and TW-132 (schedule view, Leila), both low priority with no due date.
Booth 412 is confirmed. Jordan has 40 leads, and invites go out Friday. TW-122 is due Oct 28.
Maya has a booth design review with Sam on Wednesday.
Nina is on call this week (Oct 19).
Arjun has two backend candidate interviews, Thursday and Friday (TW-110).
